svg.title: SVG Image created as hvac-observer-Isolated thermostat inputs.svg date 2026-10-06T11:19:42

g.desc: Field side: 18-30VAC design range. Each fuse: 63mA starting value, >=60VAC rating; qualify holder and interrupt rating.
Two flameproof 1k5 / 0.5W resistors per channel. No copper connection from HVAC_C to GND_SELV.
Active-low pulses: firmware latches for 150ms. Bench-check 50/60Hz, leakage, temperature and transformer loading.
H11AA1: 1/2 AC LEDs; 3 NC; 4 emitter; 5 collector; 6 base (open). R indicates control power, not a demand.
